method: Local-derived baseline with a shallow rounded underside subtracted in saved density records, then pointwise min of independently finite-gated original closed crown SDFs, at native .25m grid. Ordinary version4overrides, no visible overlapping props.

sampling.method: Every node uses independent float64 all-triangle face/edge distance; every AABB-interior node uses three independent float64 triangle ray windings without ray advancement; AABB-exterior nodes are outside. Native BVH is not used for distance or sign.
